name: Mastodon
description: Mastodon is a free, open-source social network server based on ActivityPub where users can follow friends and discover new ones..
short_desc: Mastodon is a free, open-source social network server based on ActivityPub where users can follow friends and discover n
author: linuxserver.io

form_fields.label: LOCAL_DOMAIN
form_fields.hint: This is the unique identifier of your server in the network. It cannot be safely changed later.

form_fields.label: REDIS_HOST
form_fields.hint: Redis server hostname

form_fields.label: REDIS_PORT
form_fields.hint: Redis port

form_fields.label: DB_HOST
form_fields.hint: Postgres database hostname

form_fields.label: DB_USER
form_fields.hint: Postgres username

form_fields.label: DB_NAME
form_fields.hint: Postgres db name

form_fields.label: DB_PASS
form_fields.hint: Postgres password

form_fields.label: DB_PORT
form_fields.hint: Postgres port

form_fields.label: ES_ENABLED
form_fields.hint: Enable or disable Elasticsearch (requires a separate ES instance)

form_fields.label: ACTIVE_RECORD_ENCRYPTION_PRIMARY_KEY
form_fields.hint: Primary key for Active Record Encryption.

form_fields.label: ACTIVE_RECORD_ENCRYPTION_DETERMINISTIC_KEY
form_fields.hint: Deterministic key for Active Record Encryption.

form_fields.label: ACTIVE_RECORD_ENCRYPTION_KEY_DERIVATION_SALT
form_fields.hint: Derivation salt for Active Record Encryption.

form_fields.label: SECRET_KEY_BASE
form_fields.hint: Browser session secret. Changing it will break all active browser sessions.

form_fields.label: OTP_SECRET
form_fields.hint: MFA secret. Changing it after initial setup will break two-factor authentication.

form_fields.label: VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY
form_fields.hint: Push notification private key. Changing it after initial setup will break push notifications.

form_fields.label: VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY
form_fields.hint: Push notification public key. Changing it after initial setup will break push notifications.

form_fields.label: SMTP_SERVER
form_fields.hint: SMTP server for email notifications

form_fields.label: SMTP_PORT
form_fields.hint: SMTP server port

form_fields.label: SMTP_LOGIN
form_fields.hint: SMTP username

form_fields.label: SMTP_PASSWORD
form_fields.hint: SMTP password

form_fields.label: SMTP_FROM_ADDRESS
form_fields.hint: From address for emails send from Mastodon

form_fields.label: S3_ENABLED
form_fields.hint: Enable or disable S3 storage of uploaded files

form_fields.label: WEB_DOMAIN
form_fields.hint: This can be set if you want your server identifier to be different to the subdomain hosting Mastodon. See https://docs.joinmastodon.org/admin/config/#basic

form_fields.label: ES_HOST
form_fields.hint: Elasticsearch server hostname

form_fields.label: ES_PORT
form_fields.hint: Elasticsearch port

form_fields.label: ES_USER
form_fields.hint: Elasticsearch username

form_fields.label: ES_PASS
form_fields.hint: Elasticsearch password

form_fields.label: S3_BUCKET
form_fields.hint: S3 bucket hostname

form_fields.label: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
form_fields.hint: S3 bucket access key ID

form_fields.label: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
form_fields.hint: S3 bucket secret access key

form_fields.label: S3_ALIAS_HOST
form_fields.hint: Alternate hostname for object fetching if you are front the S3 connections.

form_fields.label: SIDEKIQ_ONLY
form_fields.hint: Only run the sidekiq service in this container instance. For large scale instances that need better queue handling.

form_fields.label: SIDEKIQ_QUEUE
form_fields.hint: The name of the sidekiq queue to run in this container. See notes.

form_fields.label: SIDEKIQ_DEFAULT
form_fields.hint: Set to true on the main container if you're running additional sidekiq instances. It will run the default queue.

form_fields.label: SIDEKIQ_THREADS
form_fields.hint: The number of threads for sidekiq to use. See notes.

form_fields.label: DB_POOL
form_fields.hint: The size of the DB connection pool, must be at least the same as SIDEKIQTHREADS. See notes.

form_fields.label: NO_CHOWN
form_fields.hint: Set to true to skip chown of /config on init. READ THE APPLICATION NOTES BEFORE SETTING THIS.

form_fields.label: MASTODON_PROMETHEUS_EXPORTER_ENABLED
form_fields.hint: If set to true, Mastodon’s Ruby processes (web & Sidekiq) will enable the Prometheus instrumentation.
